svg.title: Private cloud with a central plane and three racks: control plane, compute, storage
svg.desc: A central plane with GitLab, CI/CD, a Harbor OCI registry and Keycloak accepts pushes from engineers through SSO and zero trust access. Racks pull from it, never push, and keep a local Git mirror and Harbor replica. A leaf-spine BGP fabric connects three racks. Control plane rack with Kubernetes, Cluster API, Metal3, Ironic, Argo CD, Flux, Kyverno, Sigstore, Vault, Keycloak, SPIFFE and OpenTelemetry. Compute rack with GPU nodes for vLLM and llm-d, KubeVirt, Firecracker, confidential VMs and containers with AMD SEV-SNP and Intel TDX, kubelet, OVN-Kubernetes, Cilium, Multus, Istio, Envoy, HAProxy, LoxiLB, BGP to the host with BIRD, Talos Linux and the Linux kernel with eBPF and IPsec. Storage rack with Ceph, Rook, CloudNativePG, Kafka, NATS, LINSTOR and Velero. Markers show upstream pull requests per component.
